job.job_description:
":"

We are looking for a motivated and technically sound Junior Django Developer to join our backend development team. This role is ideal for individuals at the start of their careers but with a solid grounding in software engineering principles and a strong understanding of Python and web development fundamentals.




Key Responsibilities




Develop and maintain server-side logic and APIs using Django
Collaborate with front-end developers, designers, and other team members to deliver integrated web applications
Work with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and manage schema migrations
Ensure the performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications
Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve issues across the development stack
Learn and follow best practices in Django development, security, and scalability




Requirements




Proficient in Python, with a strong understanding of Django framework
Experience with Django REST Framework (DRF)
Solid knowledge of web fundamentals HTTP, REST, client-server architecture
Experience working with relational databases and ORMs
Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for basic integration
Understanding of version control systems like Git
Awareness of common security practices and performance optimization
Strong logical thinking, problem-solving ability, and attention to detail
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)




Nice to Have

Exposure to Docker, Linux environments, or basic DevOps
Understanding of unit testing and test-driven development
Knowledge of frontend frameworks (React, Vue, etc.)
","
